prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the uploaded approved adult face-and-shoulders photo as the identity reference and preserve that adult likeness exactly. Create a top-down 4:5 close-up of the adult subject lying on densely layered abstract text-free paper sheets. His dark wavy hair is fanned out; he wears a tailored red blazer over a plain white shirt and heart-shaped chocolate-frame glasses with translucent pink lenses. Arrange deep-red roses, loose petals, an open artisan chocolate box, assorted loose chocolates, cocoa crumbs, and two red heart foil balloons around him. He holds a small folded blank paper card in one hand and the chocolate box in the other. Use warm top-left softbox light, a subtle warm rim, and a heart-shaped light pattern across part of his face and blazer. Capture natural skin pores, fabric weave, petal veins, chocolate gloss, cocoa texture, warm film grain, rich reds, and no readable text, logo, or watermark.
